```{=html}
<header class="page-header"><div class="page-shell">
<p class="eyebrow">Tool · Vaccine policy</p>
<h1>eMANDEVAL Future</h1>
<p>Prospective analysis of vaccine-mandate policy designs.</p>
</div></header>
<section class="content-section"><div class="page-shell narrow">
<div class="tool-facts">
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Problem</h2><p>Vaccine mandates combine multiple design choices, while public support, health benefits, and costs move together. Comparing alternatives by eye is difficult.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Users</h2><p>Public-health policymakers, researchers, and partner agencies considering mandate designs.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Inputs and outputs</h2><p>Users specify mandate features; the underlying tool is designed to return predicted public support, expected health outcomes, and benefit-cost comparisons across alternative designs.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Evidence base</h2><p>Predictions draw on preference estimates from discrete choice experiments on vaccine-mandate designs developed within the MandEval programme.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Developer</h2><p>Developed by Dr Mesfin Genie, Newcastle Business School, The University of Newcastle.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Limitations</h2><p>Estimates are based on stated preferences and modelling assumptions and are intended to inform, not determine, policy decisions.</p></div>
</div>
<p class="tool-notice"><strong>Application availability.</strong> The deployable standalone application files are not currently present in this GitHub repository, so this page intentionally does not expose a broken launch link.</p>
<p class="inline-links"><a href="/research/projects/mandeval/">MandEval project</a><a href="/publications/no-jab-no-access/">Related publication</a></p>
</div></section>
```
